area: Functionality and security: ZIA threat protection and SaaS Security hygiene checks (zscaler_full_checks THR.1-11, UF.5-7, SAAS.1-4), their scope and channel gating, sample tenant and snapshot reads, and the Cloud Sandbox file hash builder on Bulk changes (ops_zia_sandbox, static/ops_zia_sandbox.js)
title: Eighteen new scored checks and one write builder checked against the installed SDK 1.11.3, the Scope rule, the four write gates, untrusted input and Undo, offline on the sample tenant

checks.what: Every path, method and model field the checks read and the builder writes exists in zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 (zscaler/zia/<module>.py, models/); fields the SDK does not model are marked assumed in code comments (fileHashCount fields, EUN camelCase names, quarantine action names, alert status values)

The checks run only under ZIA platform; the SaaS Security malware rules, tenant scan state and quarantine templates are read only when SaaS Security is marked Zscaler (channel_scope ENDPOINT_CHANNELS / CHANNEL_READS); tests/test_no_implicit_reads.py passes with them
A 404 (feature not licensed) is INFO outside the score; a 401/403 is Not permitted through guard_registry; an error, empty or odd-shaped answer never crashes a check or makes it pass

Lists that hold secrets are never read: the cloud-to-cloud receivers come from the lite list (the full one carries tenantAuthorizationInfo) and the UEBA webhooks (passwords, tokens) are not read; the support e-mail in the notification settings is counted, not shown
Tenant names in findings are stripped of control characters and capped at 60 characters
Every new read has a sample tenant answer whose fields the SDK model knows, and is saved in a snapshot only when ZIA platform is ticked
Sandbox hash builder: only an MD5 (32 hex) is accepted, SHA-1/SHA-256, full-width digits, NUL and junk refused naming the line; at most 100 per operation; comments cleaned and capped

Sandbox hash builder goes through the engine: out of scope is a 400 before sign-in; write mode, writer, named assessor and an always-on typed phrase; plan hash; re-read right before the PUT with a conflict instead of an overwrite; read-back after activation; Undo removes exactly the hashes added and is accepted only as the Undo of the record; a snapshot refuses the write
The PUT replaces the whole list, so the list is sent back as re-read with every other entry untouched; an allow-listed hash is excluded, never turned into a block
The form escapes every value it draws, labels the field and announces the check result in a live region; the field has a help-catalogue entry and the builder and checks carry What's new marks

Mutation proof: removing the not-licensed answer, accepting SHA-256, dropping the re-read conflict, the SaaS channel gate or the typed phrase each makes tests in tests/test_w8_zia_threat_saas.py fail (12, 1, 1, 1 and 4 failures)

findings.title: The SDK's end_user_notification.get_eun_settings names a class it never imports (EndUserNotification), so reading /eun through the SDK client fails; the checks read it through the raw client's path instead
findings.fix: zscaler_full_checks.thr_5 reads /zia/eun (raw path); the camelCase field names are marked assumed

findings.title: The sample tenant refused every PUT to a settings object (NOT_MODELLED), so the Cloud Sandbox hash builder could not be tried offline
findings.fix: offline_tenant: a PUT to the Sandbox hash list (_SETTINGS_PUT) replaces it in the sample's memory and updates the quota; a snapshot still refuses it

findings.title: tests/test_new_marks.py hard-coded the 2026-10-28 marks (Test a list, the protocol field), so adding any newer release broke it
findings.fix: the browser checks target the releases still marked (live motion, the ZIA platform scope box) and compute the next release date from the manifest
